idea-plugin.name: Biometric Consent Audit
idea-plugin.description:
14 rules over face, fingerprint and voiceprint code: written release, destruction schedule, the 1095-day cap and the three EU AI Act prohibitions

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Biometric Consent Audit: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 14 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/biometric-consent-audit (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/biometric-consent-audit
